adjudication.rationale: In the updated loop over `calendarReference` (now an array), when `reference.credentialId` is set the code attempts to resolve `credential` from `this.calendarCredentials`, then optionally from `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)`. However, it unconditionally does `result.push(updateEvent(credential, event, bookingRefUid, calenderExternalId));` even if `credential` is still `undefined` after both lookups (no guard/early return). That can cause a runtime throw inside `updateEvent` when it dereferences properties on `credential` (e.g., `credential.appName`). The surrounding `try/catch` then returns a synthesized failure array, which would mask any other successful updates collected in `result`.
